name: de-payroll
description: German payroll for employees for pay periods in 2026: wage tax (Lohnsteuer) by tax class I to VI through the finance ministry's 2026 program flow (PAP) with the EUR 12,348 basic allowance, the Vorsorgepauschale, solidarity surcharge and church tax; the four social insurance branches (pension 18.6%, unemployment 2.6%, health 14.6% plus the fund's additional rate, average 2.9%, care 3.6% with the childless surcharge) and the 2026 ceilings; Minijobs (EUR 603), the Midijob band to EUR 2,000, the Aktivrente; the wage tax return by the 10th, contributions by the third-last bank working day, DEÜV reports, payslips, minimum wage, tax-free surcharges, sick and maternity pay, and penalties. Trigger on: Lohnsteuer, Gehaltsabrechnung, Lohnabrechnung, Entgeltabrechnung, Brutto Netto, Nettolohn, Steuerklasse, Sozialversicherung, Arbeitnehmeranteil, Arbeitgeberanteil, Beitragsbemessungsgrenze, Solidaritätszuschlag, Kirchensteuer, Rentenversicherung, Krankenversicherung, Pflegeversicherung, Arbeitslos
